partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Affected disease-associated gene baseline
results.hypothesis: A chemical that affects a gene associated with a disease may treat that disease.
results.body: chemical -affects-> gene -gene_associated_with_condition-> disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Connects a chemical to a disease-linked gene, but does not require a therapeutically corrective direction or corroborating mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: A two-edge TRAPI query can express the graph pattern; edge-property refinements would require constraints.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[:AFFECTS]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
results.description: Predict that a chemical treats a disease when the chemical affects a gene that is associated with that disease.
criteria: A ChemicalEntity has an AFFECTS edge to a Gene.
That Gene has a GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION edge to the candidate Disease.
No direction, binding, degree, provenance, or negative-evidence constraint is imposed.

results.name: Direct target with disease-gene association baseline
results.hypothesis: A chemical that directly physically interacts with a disease-associated gene may treat the disease.
results.body: chemical -directly_physically_interacts_with-> gene -gene_associated_with_condition-> disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Direct molecular interaction is stronger than generic affects, but the rule lacks direction, functional consequence, and pathway corroboration.
results.trapi_notes: The two-edge path is directly expressible in TRAPI.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Selective inhibition of a causal disease gene
results.hypothesis: A chemical may treat a disease when it selectively decreases the activity or abundance of a gene asserted to cause the disease.
results.body: chemical -affects[causes, activity_or_abundance, decreased]-> causal gene -causes-> disease; chemical qualified gene degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule links directional perturbation to a causal disease gene, but the graph does not establish whether decreased gene activity corrects or reproduces the disease mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The path and edge qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; the chemical degree constraint requires Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:Gene)-[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
results.description: Predict that a chemical treats a disease when it decreases the activity or abundance of a gene asserted to cause the disease, provided the chemical is not an extremely broad inhibitor.
criteria: The chemical has an AFFECTS assertion that causes decreased activity or abundance of a Gene.
That Gene has a CAUSES edge to the candidate Disease.
The chemical has qualifying decreased-activity-or-abundance effects on no more than 50 genes.

results.name: Multi-gene inhibition within a disease-supported process
results.hypothesis: A selective chemical may treat a disease when it decreases multiple disease-associated genes participating in the same bounded-size biological process.
results.body: disease has 3-20 associated genes in a process; chemical decreases activity_or_abundance of >=2 of those genes; chemical qualified gene degree <=100
results.mechanism_rationale: Requires coherent multi-gene perturbation and suppresses hubs, but the graph does not establish whether decreasing those genes is corrective.
results.trapi_notes: The graph motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; cardinality and degree constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (object:Disease)-[support:MINER_DISEASE_PROCESS_SUPPORT]->(process)
WHERE support.gene_count >= 3 AND support.gene_count <= 20
MATCH (targeted_gene:Gene)-[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object)
MATCH (targeted_gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(targeted_gene)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 100
WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT targeted_gene) AS targeted_disease_genes
WHERE targeted_disease_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
results.description: Predict that a chemical treats a disease when it decreases at least two disease-associated genes in the same disease-supported biological process.
criteria: The disease has a MINER_DISEASE_PROCESS_SUPPORT edge based on 3 through 20 associated genes.
At least two genes counted in that process are associated with the disease and involved in the process.
The chemical decreases the activity or abundance of each counted gene.
The chemical has qualifying decreased effects on no more than 100 genes overall.

results.name: Normalized phenotype indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A treatment for one disease may transfer to another disease when at least half of the smaller disease phenotype profile is shared and both profiles are bounded.
results.body: chemical -treats-> anchor disease; anchor and candidate disease share >=3 phenotypes; shared/min(phenotype degrees) >=0.5; each phenotype degree 3-50
results.mechanism_rationale: Phenotypic similarity supports indication transfer but does not identify the drug mechanism responsible for efficacy.
results.trapi_notes: The graph pattern is TRAPI-expressible; normalized overlap, degree limits, and source exclusion require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN [$validation_source, $blind_source]
)
  AND anchor._miner_phenotype_degree >= 3
  AND anchor._miner_phenotype_degree <= 50
MATCH (anchor)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object:Disease)
WHERE object <> anchor
  AND object._miner_phenotype_degree >= 3
  AND object._miner_phenotype_degree <= 50
WITH subject, anchor, object,
     count(DISTINCT phenotype) AS shared_phenotypes,
     anchor._miner_phenotype_degree AS anchor_phenotypes,
     object._miner_phenotype_degree AS object_phenotypes
WHERE shared_phenotypes >= 3
  AND toFloat(shared_phenotypes) /
      CASE
        WHEN anchor_phenotypes < object_phenotypes
        THEN anchor_phenotypes
        ELSE object_phenotypes
      END >= 0.5
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Normalized genetic indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A treatment for one disease may transfer to another disease when the diseases share multiple associated genes and at least half of the smaller gene profile.
results.body: chemical -treats-> anchor disease; anchor and candidate disease share >=2 associated genes; shared/min(gene degrees) >=0.5; each gene degree 2-100
results.mechanism_rationale: Genetic similarity provides a disease-mechanism bridge, but efficacy is still transferred from an existing indication.
results.trapi_notes: The graph pattern is TRAPI-expressible; normalized overlap, degree limits, and source exclusion require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN [$validation_source, $blind_source]
)
  AND anchor._miner_gene_association_degree >= 2
  AND anchor._miner_gene_association_degree <= 100
MATCH (anchor)<-[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]-(gene:Gene)
      -[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE object <> anchor
  AND object._miner_gene_association_degree >= 2
  AND object._miner_gene_association_degree <= 100
WITH subject, anchor, object,
     count(DISTINCT gene) AS shared_genes,
     anchor._miner_gene_association_degree AS anchor_genes,
     object._miner_gene_association_degree AS object_genes
WHERE shared_genes >= 2
  AND toFloat(shared_genes) /
      CASE
        WHEN anchor_genes < object_genes THEN anchor_genes ELSE object_genes
      END >= 0.5
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Specific drug binding and inhibition without adverse evidence
results.hypothesis: Precision improves when the direct-binding and inhibition rule is restricted to drugs, specific MONDO diseases, and pairs without explicit adverse relations.
results.body: drug binds and decreases causal gene; qualified gene degree <=50; MONDO disease with 1-500 descendants; no has_side_effect, contraindicated_in, exacerbates_condition, or causes edge from drug to disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Retains the same target-level evidence while excluding broad disease hubs and explicit adverse relations, but causal direction remains unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse graph patterns are TRAPI-expressible; degree and absence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

MATCH (target:Gene)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(driver)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]-(object)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(regulation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'NCBITaxon:9606' IN coalesce(target.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND anatomy._miner_human_gene_expression_degree <= 6000
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4

    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)

  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object, gene, evidence,
     collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WITH subject, object, gene, evidence,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,
         source IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, []) |
         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated
           ELSE accumulated + source
         END
       )
     ) AS binding_sources
WHERE (EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[:APPLIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
})
  AND (EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials'
        IN coalesce(trial.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
})
  AND (EXISTS {
  MATCH (subject)-[relation:TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object)
  WHERE 'infores:text-mining-provider-targeted'
        IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
})
  AND (evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 3)
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: drug directly binds LOF Gene2Phenotype driver and increases both activity and abundance
results.mechanism_rationale: Two explicit molecular aspects agree on restoration of an LOF causal protein.
results.trapi_notes: The binding, activity, abundance, and variant-qualified disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; provenance and disease constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[activity:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (subject)-[abundance:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE activity.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND activity.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity'
  AND activity.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  AND abundance.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND abundance.object_aspect_qualifier = 'abundance'
  AND abundance.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  AND activity <> abundance
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

MATCH (subject:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->

WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)

MATCH (target)-[target_process]->(process:BiologicalProcess)
      <-[driver_process]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased', 'decreased']
  AND type(target_process) IN ['ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_POSITIVE_EFFECT',
       'ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_NEGATIVE_EFFECT',
       'ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_OR_WITHIN_POSITIVE_EFFECT',
       'ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_OR_WITHIN_NEGATIVE_EFFECT']
  AND type(driver_process) IN ['ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_POSITIVE_EFFECT',
       'ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_NEGATIVE_EFFECT',

       'ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_OR_WITHIN_NEGATIVE_EFFECT']

      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])

  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object,
     collect(DISTINCT
       CASE WHEN
         CASE effect.object_direction_qualifier
           WHEN 'increased' THEN 1 ELSE -1

         CASE WHEN type(target_process) CONTAINS 'POSITIVE'

results.body: R264 excluding contradictory increased activity on every counted target
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule retains multi-target disease coverage and repeated directional evidence while removing graph-native target-direction contradictions.
results.trapi_notes: Positive and opposite-direction paths are TRAPI-expressible; absence, evidence count, rank, cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite:AFFECTS]->(gene)
    WHERE opposite.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
      AND opposite.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }

  AND coalesce(
        effect.evidence_count,
        size(coalesce(effect.publications, [])),
        1
      ) >= 2


WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
results.description: Predict that a drug treats a specific MONDO disease when it binds and repeatedly decreases at least two of the disease's top three genes, and none of those genes also has an opposite increased-activity assertion for the drug.
criteria: The candidate is a MONDO disease with at least one superclass and no more than 500 ontology descendants.
For each counted Gene, the drug directly physically interacts with it and decreases its activity or abundance.
Each counted Gene ranks among the disease's top three genes and each decreased-effect edge has at least two evidence items or publications.
The drug has no AFFECTS assertion that increases the activity or abundance of any counted Gene.
At least two distinct qualifying genes are counted.

results.name: Dual-target dual-driver physical bridge
results.hypothesis: A drug can suppress a disease module when two distinct inhibited targets independently contact two distinct top-ranked causal disease drivers.
results.body: drug decreases two bound targets; each target directly interacts with a different top-three causal driver
results.mechanism_rationale: Two intervention arms reach two independent causal drivers and avoid dependence on one interaction hub, but driver-specific disease direction is not encoded.
results.trapi_notes: The repeated target, effect, interaction, and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; distinct-node constraints, rank, and ontology filters require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(target1)
MATCH (target1)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver1:Gene)
MATCH (driver1)-[evidence1:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(target2)
MATCH (target2)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver2:Gene)
MATCH (driver2)-[evidence2:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE target1.id < target2.id
  AND driver1.id < driver2.id
  AND target1 <> driver1
  AND target2 <> driver2
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence1._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND evidence2._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.description: Predict that a drug treats a specific MONDO disease when it binds and decreases a top-three disease gene in a GO pathway genetically associated with the disease, provided the molecular evidence is nonblind and ChEMBL does not record a black-box-warning value.

GOA places the inhibited target Gene in that process.
The target has graph-derived disease evidence and ranks among the disease's top three genes.
The drug directly physically interacts with the target and decreases its activity or abundance.
The drug's chembl_black_box_warning property is absent.
